name: DFE ClickHouse Internals
description: The long tail: caches, merges, mutations, replication, storage layout and per-user query behaviour, for when the Overview says something is wrong but not what.

config.name: Server
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT hostName() AS "Host",
       version() AS "Version",
       uptime() AS "Uptime seconds",
       formatReadableTimeDelta(uptime()) AS "Uptime"

config.name: Cluster topology
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT cluster AS "Cluster",
       shard_num AS "Shard",
       replica_num AS "Replica",
       host_name AS "Host",
       port AS "Port",
       is_local AS "Local",
       errors_count AS "Errors",
       slowdowns_count AS "Slowdowns"
FROM system.clusters
ORDER BY cluster, shard_num, replica_num

config.name: Queries by user
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS ts,
       initial_user AS "User",
       count() AS "Queries"
FROM system.query_log
WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY ts, initial_user
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Queries by kind
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS ts,
       query_kind AS "Kind",
       count() AS "Queries"
FROM system.query_log
WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY ts, query_kind
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Per-query memory
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS ts,
       max(memory_usage) AS "Peak",
       quantile(0.99)(memory_usage) AS "p99",
       avg(memory_usage) AS "Mean"
FROM system.query_log
WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Rows read against rows written
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS ts,
       sum(read_rows) AS "Read",
       sum(written_rows) AS "Written"
FROM system.query_log
WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Slowest individual queries
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT event_time AS "When",
       query_duration_ms AS "Duration ms",
       initial_user AS "User",
       substring(query_id, 1, 8) AS "Query id",
       query_kind AS "Kind",
       normalizeQuery(query) AS "Query",
       read_rows AS "Rows read",
       formatReadableSize(read_bytes) AS "Bytes read",
       formatReadableSize(memory_usage) AS "Memory"
FROM system.query_log
WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
ORDER BY query_duration_ms DESC
LIMIT 25

config.name: Failed queries
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT event_time AS "When",
       initial_user AS "User",
       exception_code AS "Code",
       any(exception) AS "Exception",
       count() AS "Occurrences",
       any(normalizeQuery(query)) AS "Query"
FROM system.query_log
WHERE type IN ('ExceptionBeforeStart', 'ExceptionWhileProcessing')
  AND $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY event_time, initial_user, exception_code
ORDER BY event_time DESC
LIMIT 25

config.name: Cache hit rate
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       sum(ProfileEvent_MarkCacheHits) / nullIf(sum(ProfileEvent_MarkCacheHits) + sum(ProfileEvent_MarkCacheMisses), 0) AS "Mark cache",
       sum(ProfileEvent_UncompressedCacheHits) / nullIf(sum(ProfileEvent_UncompressedCacheHits) + sum(ProfileEvent_UncompressedCacheMisses), 0) AS "Uncompressed cache",
       sum(ProfileEvent_PrimaryIndexCacheHits) / nullIf(sum(ProfileEvent_PrimaryIndexCacheHits) + sum(ProfileEvent_PrimaryIndexCacheMisses), 0) AS "Primary index cache",
       sum(ProfileEvent_PageCacheHits) / nullIf(sum(ProfileEvent_PageCacheHits) + sum(ProfileEvent_PageCacheMisses), 0) AS "Page cache"
FROM merge('system', '^metric_log')
WHERE $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

config.name: In-memory cache size
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       avg(CurrentMetric_MarkCacheBytes) AS "Marks",
       avg(CurrentMetric_UncompressedCacheBytes) AS "Uncompressed",
       avg(CurrentMetric_PrimaryIndexCacheBytes) AS "Primary index",
       avg(CurrentMetric_QueryCacheBytes) AS "Query results",
       avg(CurrentMetric_PageCacheBytes) AS "Page cache"
FROM merge('system', '^metric_log')
WHERE $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Query result cache
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       sum(ProfileEvent_QueryCacheHits) AS "Hits",
       sum(ProfileEvent_QueryCacheMisses) AS "Misses",
       avg(CurrentMetric_QueryCacheEntries) AS "Entries"
FROM merge('system', '^metric_log')
WHERE $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Merges in flight
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT concat(database, '.', table) AS "Table",
       round(100 * progress, 1) AS "Progress %",
       round(elapsed, 1) AS "Elapsed s",
       is_mutation AS "Mutation",
       partition_id AS "Partition",
       num_parts AS "Source parts",
       formatReadableSize(total_size_bytes_compressed) AS "Total size",
       formatReadableSize(memory_usage) AS "Memory"
FROM system.merges
ORDER BY progress DESC

config.name: Merges completed by table
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS ts,
       concat(database, '.', table) AS "Table",
       count() AS "Merges"
FROM system.part_log
WHERE event_type = 'MergeParts' AND $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY ts, database, table
ORDER BY ts

config.name: New parts written by table
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS ts,
       concat(database, '.', table) AS "Table",
       count() AS "Parts"
FROM system.part_log
WHERE event_type = 'NewPart' AND $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY ts, database, table
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Mutations
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT concat(database, '.', table) AS "Table",
       mutation_id AS "Mutation",
       command AS "Command",
       create_time AS "Created",
       length(parts_to_do_names) AS "Parts remaining",
       is_done AS "Done",
       if(latest_fail_time = '1970-01-01 00:00:00', '', latest_fail_reason) AS "Failure"
FROM system.mutations
ORDER BY is_done ASC, create_time DESC
LIMIT 25

config.name: Replicated tables
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT concat(database, '.', table) AS "Table",
       is_leader AS "Leader",
       is_readonly AS "Read only",
       is_session_expired AS "Session expired",
       absolute_delay AS "Delay s",
       queue_size AS "Queue",
       inserts_in_queue AS "Inserts queued",
       merges_in_queue AS "Merges queued",
       total_replicas AS "Replicas",
       active_replicas AS "Active"
FROM system.replicas
ORDER BY absolute_delay DESC
LIMIT 25

config.name: Replication queue
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT concat(database, '.', table) AS "Table",
       type AS "Type",
       num_tries AS "Tries",
       create_time AS "Created",
       last_exception AS "Last exception"
FROM system.replication_queue
ORDER BY num_tries DESC
LIMIT 25

config.name: Keeper traffic
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       sum(ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperTransactions) AS "Transactions",
       sum(ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperHardwareExceptions) AS "Hardware exceptions",
       sum(ProfileEvent_ZooKeeperOtherExceptions) AS "Other exceptions",
       avg(CurrentMetric_ZooKeeperWatch) AS "Watches"
FROM merge('system', '^metric_log')
WHERE $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Disks
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT name AS "Disk",
       path AS "Path",
       formatReadableSize(total_space) AS "Total",
       formatReadableSize(free_space) AS "Free",
       round(100 * (1 - free_space / nullIf(total_space, 0)), 1) AS "Used %"
FROM system.disks
ORDER BY name

config.name: Databases by size
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT database AS "Database",
       uniq(table) AS "Tables",
       uniq(table, partition) AS "Partitions",
       count() AS "Parts",
       sum(rows) AS "Rows",
       formatReadableSize(sum(bytes_on_disk)) AS "On disk",
       formatReadableSize(sum(data_uncompressed_bytes)) AS "Uncompressed"
FROM system.parts
WHERE active
GROUP BY database
ORDER BY sum(bytes_on_disk) DESC

config.name: Tables by size
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT concat(database, '.', table) AS "Table",
       sum(rows) AS "Rows",
       formatReadableSize(sum(bytes_on_disk)) AS "On disk",
       formatReadableSize(sum(data_uncompressed_bytes)) AS "Uncompressed",
       round(sum(data_uncompressed_bytes) / nullIf(sum(data_compressed_bytes), 0), 1) AS "Compression",
       count() AS "Parts",
       uniq(partition) AS "Partitions",
       max(modification_time) AS "Last written"
FROM system.parts
WHERE active
GROUP BY database, table
ORDER BY sum(bytes_on_disk) DESC
LIMIT 50

config.name: Worst parts per partition
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT concat(database, '.', table) AS "Table",
       count() AS "Partitions",
       sum(part_count) AS "Parts",
       max(part_count) AS "Max per partition"
FROM (
  SELECT database, table, partition, count() AS part_count
  FROM system.parts
  WHERE active
  GROUP BY database, table, partition
)
GROUP BY database, table
ORDER BY "Max per partition" DESC
LIMIT 20

config.name: Detached parts
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT concat(database, '.', table) AS "Table",
       reason AS "Reason",
       count() AS "Parts",
       any(name) AS "Example"
FROM system.detached_parts
GROUP BY database, table, reason
ORDER BY "Parts" DESC
LIMIT 25

config.name: Table engines in use
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT engine AS "Engine",
       count() AS "Tables"
FROM system.tables
WHERE database NOT IN ('system', 'INFORMATION_SCHEMA', 'information_schema')
GROUP BY engine
ORDER BY "Tables" DESC

config.name: Widest tables
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT concat(database, '.', table) AS "Table",
       count() AS "Columns"
FROM system.columns
WHERE database NOT IN ('system', 'INFORMATION_SCHEMA', 'information_schema')
GROUP BY database, table
ORDER BY "Columns" DESC
LIMIT 20

config.name: Background pool tasks
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       avg(CurrentMetric_BackgroundMergesAndMutationsPoolTask) AS "Merges and mutations",
       avg(CurrentMetric_BackgroundCommonPoolTask) AS "Common",
       avg(CurrentMetric_BackgroundSchedulePoolTask) AS "Schedule",
       avg(CurrentMetric_BackgroundFetchesPoolTask) AS "Fetches",
       avg(CurrentMetric_BackgroundMovePoolTask) AS "Moves"
FROM merge('system', '^metric_log')
WHERE $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Threads and open files
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       avg(CurrentMetric_GlobalThreadActive) AS "Global threads active",
       avg(CurrentMetric_QueryThread) AS "Query threads",
       avg(CurrentMetric_OpenFileForRead) AS "Files open for read",
       avg(CurrentMetric_OpenFileForWrite) AS "Files open for write"
FROM merge('system', '^metric_log')
WHERE $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Async insert queue
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       avg(CurrentMetric_AsynchronousInsertQueueSize) AS "Queued blocks",
       avg(CurrentMetric_AsynchronousInsertQueueBytes) AS "Queued bytes",
       sum(ProfileEvent_AsyncInsertQuery) AS "Async inserts",
       sum(ProfileEvent_FailedAsyncInsertQuery) AS "Failed async inserts"
FROM merge('system', '^metric_log')
WHERE $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Host load and OS CPU
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       avgIf(value, metric = 'LoadAverage15') AS "Load average 15m",
       avgIf(value, metric = 'OSUserTimeNormalized') AS "OS CPU userspace",
       avgIf(value, metric = 'OSSystemTimeNormalized') AS "OS CPU kernel"
FROM merge('system', '^asynchronous_metric_log')
WHERE metric IN ('LoadAverage15', 'OSUserTimeNormalized', 'OSSystemTimeNormalized')
  AND $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts
